why: Dogfood miss from PR #102 / issue #111: WebhookControllerTest stubbed reviewDispatcher.dispatch(...) to throw RuntimeException("executor saturated"), but the real ReviewDispatcher.dispatch() catches RejectedExecutionException internally and returns false — it never throws to its caller. The green test made a broken rollback path look proven. With both the mock and the real method in the provided material, the review prompt must surface the unfaithful stub. Keywords cover how the finding is worded: on glm-5.3-flash it named the stub 'impossible' or said the real method 'no longer produces' the exception (#979), which the original four keywords missed.
prTitle: fix(webhook): roll back dedup slot when dispatch fails (#89)
prDescription:
- [x] 🐛 Bug fix

Fixes #89

Adds forget(deliveryId) when routeEvent catches a RuntimeException from a saturated review executor.
